title: 2× inconsistent return statements (R1710) — functions at lines 334, 341
detail: 2 functions have code paths that return a value and paths that fall through implicitly. Callers expecting a return value silently receive `None` on the implicit path, a latent `AttributeError` or `TypeError` risk. Fix: add explicit `return None` on all implicit paths, or normalize return type.

title: too-many-branches (R0912) — function(s) at line 200
detail: A function has more branches than pylint's threshold. High branch count multiplies test cases needed for coverage and makes the function a defect magnet. Fix: extract decision clusters into named helper functions.
